original_incident_single_client.note: The original incident: one client, random numbers. Stopped by the per-session cap (3 per 10 min).

datacenter_rotation_default_config.note: Default config: the web source cap (5/min) bounds it.

datacenter_rotation_caps_lifted.note: Source caps lifted: the datacenter ASN cap (50/min) alone bounds it.

residential_rotation_feedback_loop.note: Every static limit removed; unique residential IP per request. Only the verification feedback loop sees it.

sequential_number_walk.note: Caps lifted; fresh fingerprint per request (+20). Phase 1: young fingerprint plus the narrow-range signal reach only the delay tier, which still sends. Phase 2, after the 10-minute verification window with zero conversions, the conversion penalty (+25) stacks on top and every further request lands in the challenge tier: no more SMS.

legitimate_user_journey.note: Real user verifies once; a week later they are trusted: lower score, no HLR spend.

global_circuit_breaker.note: At 80 % the breaker goes elevated, at 100 % emergency: clean traffic (score < 10) still gets SMS, anything riskier is downgraded.
